card.name: Digits before ordinal endings like st/th
card.fires_on: A digit just before an ordinal ending such as st, th or nd, as in dates (14th of October) and century or rank numbers. Also fires on a few other word starts in historical text.

modes.label: Digit before ordinal ending
modes.description: The last digit of a number written as an ordinal, e.g. 1st, 8th, 15th, in dates and centuries.
modes.example: Early in the forenoon of the <<8>>th of May as Palo Alto was approached

modes.label: Other word starts in history text
modes.description: Isolated first letters or titles in names, or a variable in a math formula.
